lastSummary: Three-layer enforcement hardening + finished the stalled P2 hook consolidation. Fixed retrieval CI ETIMEDOUT (hashing + --ignore-scripts). Promoted comment-lint from advisory to blocking. Added commit-time doc gate via .beads/hooks/pre-commit chain. Hardened pre-push-gate with claude/* refusal, remote-CI check, evals + docs jobs. Wired up policy-engine.mjs (was phantom — had logic but no registration) and added new Stop-time policies (red-CI block, open-beads block, drive-session advisory). Removed 9 phantom registrations from settings.template.json. Added phantom-hook drift check to construct doctor.
decisions: Retrieval evals CI pins CONSTRUCT_EMBEDDING_MODEL=hashing because the eval fixture is calibrated against hashing-bow-v1; the ONNX runtime postinstall is unnecessary and a CDN flake.
comment-lint is blocking at PostToolUse. Bypass: CONSTRUCT_SKIP_COMMENT_LINT=1.
Strict doc-coupling gate: any staged lib/|bin/|src/|app/ code change requires CHANGELOG.md or docs/* or .cx/context.* in the same commit. Bypass: CONSTRUCT_SKIP_DOCS=1.

Stop-time enforcement consolidated in policy-engine.mjs rather than fanning out to standalone hooks. Per multi-level audit: the P2 consolidation effort that deprecated 9 hook files was stalled mid-flight — policy-engine.mjs existed but was never registered, only bootstrap + drive logic was implemented. Finishing the consolidation honors the original architectural intent and keeps the hook budget under 34 (currently 34).
Hard-block on Stop when remote CI is red on the current branch. Bypass: CONSTRUCT_STOP_OK_RED_CI=1.
Hard-block on Stop when bd issues are in_progress. Bypass: CONSTRUCT_STOP_OK_OPEN_BD=1.
Refuse to push claude/* branches to remote. Bypass: CONSTRUCT_ALLOW_CLAUDE_PUSH=1.
construct doctor now treats phantom-hook drift (registered but missing files) as a critical (non-optional) check.
pendingTodos: Configure GitHub branch protection to mark 'retrieval evals', 'comment policy', 'docs drift check', and 'dependency CVE audit' as required status checks on main and dev (user-side gh api command, surfaced in plan).

Implement the remaining stalled consolidations: task rule (PreToolUse on workflow_update_task), workflow rule (UserPromptSubmit), MCP scope rule (PreToolUse on MCP calls). Tracked in docs/hooks-deprecated.md.
Close construct-b5c (cross-surface parity verifier) — both gaps folded in: Codex surface coverage + non-optional doctor check.
efficiencySummary: Single planning + implementation session with mid-course audit-driven pivot (standalone hooks → policy-engine consolidation). Final hook count: 34/34 budget.
contextSummary: Enforcement architecture is now defense-in-depth: real-time (write), gate (commit/push), safety net (CI + session end). Every blocking gate has an explicit env-var bypass. Phantom hook drift is no longer possible because construct doctor catches it. The P2 hook consolidation that was stalled mid-flight is now finished and wired up — policy-engine.mjs is registered for PreToolUse/Stop/UserPromptSubmit and the deprecation ledger honestly documents what's implemented vs. still-stalled.
